notes.title: Pang in Time - Time has arrived! Releasing this month!
notes.content:
Get ready for a nostalgia trip! [b]Pang in Time[/b], the beloved arcade game, is making its way to Steam! Blast through time and pop those pesky bubbles in this updated classic. Journey from prehistoric Pangaea to futuristic space stations, armed with your trusty harpoon. Enjoy enhanced graphics, wacky power-ups, and the same addictive gameplay you remember. Challenge your friends, conquer the levels, and become the ultimate Pang master! 
Wishlist Pang in Time on Steam now!
